_help: The Post's own calendar — the only place Post and Auxiliary events are kept. Two lists: "repeating" rules (expanded on the page and in calendar.ics) and one-off "events". Times are local Eastern. A rule: every: "week" or "month"; weekday: Monday–Sunday; which (month only): "first", "second", "third", "fourth" or "last"; time/end as HH:MM; from/until as YYYY-MM-DD (optional); moves: {"usual date": "new date"} to shift one occurrence; skip: ["date"] to cancel one. One-off events use the same fields as data/events-area.json (title, start, end, location, description, url, source).

events.title: Feed Dating: Around the World in 8 Dates
events.location: VFW Post 4651, 7 Haven Ave, Cranston, RI 02920
events.description: Culinary speed dating at the Post, hosted by Chef Kimberly Andrade (Chef's Soulful Compass). Eight 10-minute dates over six internationally inspired tasting courses. Limited to 8 women and 8 men; 21+. $75 per person, with an optional $5 donation to the Post; tickets through Eventbrite. The menu is fixed and cannot accommodate allergies or dietary restrictions.

events.title: '80s Halloween Party at the Post
events.location: VFW Post 4651, 7 Haven Ave, Cranston, RI 02920
events.description: Back-to-the-'80s Halloween party inside the Post, hosted by Jessica and Marissa. Costumes encouraged, with music, contests and prizes.

events.title: The Dinner Circle: Night in New Orleans
events.location: VFW Post 4651, 7 Haven Ave, Cranston, RI 02920
events.description: Three-course, family-style dinner at the Post with Louisiana dishes, cooked by Chef Kimberly Andrade (Chef's Soulful Compass). Come solo, with friends or as a date night; 21+. $35 per person; tickets through Eventbrite. The menu is set, so anyone with food allergies or dietary needs should contact the chef before buying.

events.title: Trivia Night at the Post
events.location: VFW Post 4651, 7 Haven Ave, Cranston, RI 02920
events.description: Weekly trivia night at the Post, hosted by Logiq & Kobi D. with music by DJ Rukiz. Teams of four, three rounds, one winner each week; categories include music, TV theme songs, movies, sports and general knowledge. Doors open at 7 p.m.; trivia starts at 8. Free admission. The 10-week season ends with a finale for a $500 prize.

events.title: Poppy Drive at Dave's Marketplace
events.location: Dave's Marketplace, 550 Pontiac Ave, Cranston, RI
events.description: The Post's first joint event with its newly installed Auxiliary. Post and Auxiliary members hand out poppies at Dave's Marketplace in exchange for donations. Wear a poppy, support a veteran: every dollar stays local to help veterans, their families and programs here in our community.
